title: C10E2 - C10E2
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
symptoms: Flashing LED on Parking Fren Switch
Parking Fren warning message in Gösterge Paneli
commonCauses: Faulty Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri or Connections
Low battery voltage (may cause component damage)
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin: /repair electrical wiring or connections
Değiştirin / Yenileyin:  faulty Automatic parking Fren Motor
technicalNotes: Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: the 03-ABS Fren module on MQB (Mk7 chassis) vehicles with an Electro-Mechanical Parking Fren (EPB) see post #8 in this thread
